description: Miles Promo Feed policy — promotion ENRICHMENT only. One keyless fetch of AwardWallet's public current buy-points/miles promotions page; only the airline table is parsed. Award results remain the source of truth for miles/taxes/availability — a promo never changes them, and an effective cost is only ever echoed when the source states one. Program identity is this explicit map (source's parenthesized program name, lowercased → our award loyaltyProgram enum) — never a fuzzy name heuristic; unmapped rows stay in the feed but enrich nothing.

source.note: Promos move daily at most; one polite request per TTL. A blocked answer (403/429/503/bot-wall) is cached like any other outcome so it is NEVER retried in a loop — only an explicit forced refresh asks again.
